stem: Match each relation with its type.
explanation: $3x + 2$ is one-one. $x^{2}$ sends $\pm a$ to the same value (many-one). $y^{2} = x$ gives two $y$ for each $x$ (one-many). On the circle each $x$ in $(-5, 5)$ has two $y$ values and most $y$ values have two $x$ values (many-many). Only the first two are functions.

stem: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = \dfrac{2x + 1}{x - 3}$ for $x > 3$. Show that $f$ is one-one.

points.description: A1 expands and simplifies to $-7a = -7b$ (the $ab$ terms cancel)
A1 concludes $a = b$, so $f$ is one-one

answerSpec.modelAnswer:
Suppose $f(a) = f(b)$ with $a, b > 3$. Then
$$
(2a + 1)(b - 3) = (2b + 1)(a - 3)
$$
$$
2ab - 6a + b - 3 = 2ab - 6b + a - 3
$$
$$
-7a = -7b \quad\Rightarrow\quad a = b
$$
Equal outputs only come from equal inputs, so $f$ is one-one. (Alternatively, $f(x) = 2 + \frac{7}{x - 3}$ is strictly decreasing for $x > 3$.)

explanation: Show that $f(a) = f(b)$ forces $a = b$; the $2ab$ and $-3$ terms cancel on both sides.
